description: This source file contains the implementation of the RandomData interface in the Apache Commons Math library. It provides methods for generating various types of random data, including secure and non-secure random values, from different probability distributions, and includes reseeding capabilities.

classes.name: RandomDataImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the RandomData interface, providing methods to generate diverse random data and distributions, allowing reseeding and configuration of secure random generators. It delegates core functionality to an internal RandomDataGenerator instance.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a hexadecimal string of specified length using random bytes.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a random integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a random long value within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a secure hexadecimal string of specified length using cryptographically strong random bytes and SHA-1 hashing.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Returns a secure random integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Returns a secure random long within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed random number with given mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a normally-distributed random number with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates an exponential-distributed random number with specified mean.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Returns a uniformly-distributed double within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Returns a uniformly-distributed double within bounds, optionally with endpoint inclusion.

methods.name: nextBeta
methods.description: Samples a value from the Beta distribution using inversion.

methods.name: nextBinomial
methods.description: Samples a value from the Binomial distribution using inversion.

methods.name: nextCauchy
methods.description: Samples from Cauchy distribution.

methods.name: nextChiSquare
methods.description: Samples from Chi-Square distribution.

methods.name: nextF
methods.description: Samples from F distribution.

methods.name: nextGamma
methods.description: Samples from Gamma distribution.

methods.name: nextHypergeometric
methods.description: Samples from Hypergeometric distribution.

methods.name: nextPascal
methods.description: Samples from Pascal (Negative Binomial) distribution.

methods.name: nextT
methods.description: Samples from Student's T distribution.

methods.name: nextWeibull
methods.description: Samples from Weibull distribution.

methods.name: nextZipf
methods.description: Samples from Zipf distribution.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the non-secure pseudo-random generator.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator with current time.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure generator with provided seed.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the generator with current time plus hash code.

methods.name: setSecureAlgorithm
methods.description: Configures the security provider and algorithm for SecureRandom.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Generates a random permutation of n elements choosing k.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Returns a sample of k elements from a collection, using a permutation shuffle.

methods.name: nextInversionDeviate
methods.description: Generates a deviate from a real distribution using the inversion method.

methods.name: nextInversionDeviate
methods.description: Generates a deviate from an integer distribution using the inversion method.
